answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake bond before it can trade or vote. One bond backs one identity, like a single quill signing one ledger entry, so a Sybil attacker who wants a thousand fake voices must lock a thousand bonds. The bond sits untouched while the agent behaves, but fraud or spam slashes it, turning each fake identity from free into expensive. Honest agents recover their stake, while an attacker crossing a mesa of fake accounts finds the cost rising with every jetty they try to build, because each new crossing demands fresh capital at risk.
